_doc: FEAT-181: every tunable of tools/ghost_lines.mjs. `defaults` are the values that worked on Vail (docs/research/ghost-lines-prototype/README.md); `resorts.<slug>` overrides any of them for one resort (the same nesting, only the keys that differ). Tuning is editing this file, not code; note each change in the README's Learnings.

extract._doc: a drawn pixel: saturation over sat and value over value, or every channel under blackMax; not in the render (no render pixel within 2 px closer than notInRender in any channel); drawn colours are hue peaks at least hueSplit degrees apart, a pixel joining the peak nearest in hue + valueWeight x value (0..255) within joinCost; two strokes of one colour whose ends meet within joinPx, the gap carrying on the way both run, are one line; a line is at least minCells cells of cellPx. A JPEG softens colours and black: jpeg replaces any of these for one

fit._doc: a snip (not the tool's own drawing frame): the shot rendered renderWidth wide at `phases` drift phases, matched over scales sMin..sMax; under minMatch is a warning

cast._doc: rays marched out to maxM; a line splits where neighbouring hits jump over max(jumpM, jumpFrac x distance), the longest run kept (every run of minRun+ points when the rider is then on screen under minInViewS)

waypoints._doc: from the high end, each lower than the last, spacingFrac x distance from the camera apart (minM..maxM); reached within reachFrac of that spacing (reachMinM..reachedM)

bot._doc: the steering bot on the rider physics (fall line off). It follows the line smoothed over smoothFrac x its distance from the camera (up to smoothMaxM), aiming lookFrac x speed ahead (lookMinM..lookMaxM), in linked turns: a sine across the path with a wavelength of turnBaseM + turnFrac x the distance (turnMinM..turnMaxM) and a width that starts at turnStartShare of it and grows when faster than the speed wanted, shrinks when slower (turnGain m per m/s per s, turnMinShare..turnMaxShare; close to the camera at least turnNearShare of it, full from swingFullM, where the drawn wiggles are the turns; none for a straightliner). The speed wanted: brakeFrac x the distance from the camera (brakeMin..brakeOver m/s), mogulOver where the moguls (pack.mogulAmp) are over mogulAmpM (no tuck there), straightOver for a straightliner (--per name:n:straight, always tucked). The brake is a backstop: on at brakeBand over it, off at it. Steering = clamp(steerGain x heading error, +-steerCap), eased in over steerEaseS. In the air no steering and a grab (a crooked landing without one crashes). Skip ahead 10 m after stallS under stallSpeed; start at startSpeed out of sight (beyond crestBeyondM never back over a crest); end endAfterS after out of sight, or tailS after the line while still in view; at most maxS; extend (a recorded take that ends in view) rides on down the fall line until out of sight, at most extendMaxS

group._doc: riders per variant (riders) and variants per line (variants: the line shifted variantShiftFrac x its distance from the camera, variantShiftMinM..MaxM, to one side then the other, its own carving rhythm, partners on the other side); a line's variants set off every (its longest ride + restS) / variants seconds, lines offset from each other; the first partner gapM across (+-driftM over driftPeriodS), lagS behind; each further one gapMinM..gapMaxM further out on alternating sides, lagS more behind; never two within minGapM (else the gaps grow by loosen); a partner that would start in view within nearM swaps sides; all trimmed to cutBeforeS before the first comes into sight; takes (variants of a recorded run): shifted takeShiftM to one side, then the other

outfits._doc: OUTFIT_PRESETS names; a line whose median cast distance is over farM gets the bright ones

check._doc: the report's limits: lead to partner pairMinM..pairMaxM; any two takes (new and existing) closer than takeGapM while both ride; menu frames at times (s) for the pictures and the draw calls
